verdict: key consistent: 86 signs = 86 letters, 21 groups for 22 words (يهدي مني written as one group across the row end), one letter per shape; homophones ي (S4 barred U, S11 plain U), ن (S1, S12 once: the د sign with a dot added), ب (S19, S22 once). Needs four corrections to the record's plaintext, all supported by the page; the second وردا is enciphered with ر and د transposed
notes: Rows 6r l.11-13 (image 0084_0016) and 6v l.1-4 (image 0084_0017). Signs per row 14,12,12,13,16,14,5 = 86 (record 15,13,14,13,16,15,5 = 91); dividers 3,3,4,3,3,3(one opening the row),2 = 21 (record 20). No divider at the 6r l.11/12 row end, so يهدي مني is one group of 7 (override); the other row ends without a divider fall inside words (اضل, جبلا, وغصنا, والطلا). On 6r l.13 a sign at the paper crack between the divider and S9 is reduced to two short strokes; read as Λ (ا) for بها. In وصلا the ص (S14) is cut by the same crack. Record errors (cipher and page agree): (1) فدا لمن, not فدا من (3 signs ل م ن; the page has لمن); (2) وصلا شعرا, not وصلا لا شعر (4 signs ش ع ر ا after وصلا; no لا); (3) the cipher writes اضل | بها as two groups (ا ض ل / ب ه ا), the record has اضلها; (4) the last group is وطلا (4 signs و ط ل ا, with ط = the double crescent as in والطلا), i.e. the small 'طلا' written above the final و on 6v l.8 belongs to the line, and the record's stray و is the start of وطلا. With these the totals match exactly (86 = 86); the record's count excess (+9) came from segmenter overcounts and the misread words. S12 (ن in مني) is the د sign S10 with a dot inside its loop: kept as its own shape (a dotted variant reading ن; the alternative, مدي, makes no sense). The second وردا (6v l.3, after بدر) is written و S10 S17 ا = ودرا: the encipherer transposed د and ر (the first وردا, 6v l.1, has و S17 S10 ا, and S17 = ر in شعرا, قربه, بدر; S10 = د in فدا, يهدي, ودجى, بدر); the draft keys it as written (cipher form ودرا). S5 of the first pass (the د in فدا) was merged into S10 after comparing at 3x; the label S5 is not used.
